raw_output:
alias: 有人时把灯调暗
description: 当检测到有人时，将灯调暗
triggers:
  - platform: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.hall_motion
    to: 'on'
  - platform: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.bedroom_motion
    to: 'on'
actions:
  - service: light.turn_on
    data:
      brightness: 100
    target:
      entity_id: light.living_main
  - service: light.turn_on
    data:
      brightness: 100
    target:
      entity_id: light.bedroom_main
  - service: light.turn_on
    data:
      brightness: 100
    target:
      entity_id: light.hall
mode: single
